opening.quote: Good afternoon, thank you for calling Tidewell Home, brum speaking.
opening.comment: You greeted the caller and gave the company name, but your name was given as 'brum' rather than Bram; state your name clearly and correctly.

verification.quote: Sure, happy to yeah help with it. What's the new e-mail address?
verification.comment: You changed account data without first confirming the caller's full name and an order number or account postcode; always verify identity before making changes.

understanding.quote: Done, I've updated the account too eva.smit@example.com.
understanding.comment: You misrecorded the email address as eva.smit instead of efa.smit, so the caller's actual request was not captured accurately; read the address back to confirm it.

resolution_accuracy.quote: Yes, your lamp shipped this morning and arrives in 2 to 4 working days.
resolution_accuracy.comment: The shipping timeline of 2 to 4 working days matches the standard delivery policy, but the account update was wrongly applied to a different email address, which is a factual error.

process_compliance.quote: Done, I've updated the account too eva.smit@example.com.
process_compliance.comment: No required process step was triggered by this call, so compliance is met; the verification failure is scored under verification.

communication.comment: The caller was not frustrated, so no acknowledgement was needed, but the reply was abrupt and did not thank the caller; use a warmer, complete closing phrase.

closing.comment: The call ended without confirming next steps clearly or asking if there was anything else, so close by summarizing the outcome and asking if you can help further.
